description: Every account the memory holds: id, name, type (its tag), institution and last4 when present, belongs_to (the person it belongs to), linked_to (the account it is linked to: a card to the bank account that pays it), balance with balance_date, notes — what is particular about it, one detail per line, a card's name ("Card name: …", the thing to look up for offers) among them — details as stored when it holds any, how many commitments and charges are billed to it, and its next unpaid charge.
name: accounts
title: List accounts
